text:
Alex G.: Heads-up — after yesterday's microkernel change, /chat-stream saw a TTFT spike around 23:12 UTC for short payloads. Putting initial traces here.

Alex G.: Repro steps: send short 8-token prompts at ~50 qps on dedicated pool; median TTFT jumped from ~18ms -> ~55ms. Quick perf dump below.

Alex G.: ```
prequeue_ms: 3-5
kernel_ms: 40-48
decode_ms: 6-8
kv_hit_rate: 62%
notes: kernel path = microkernel (fallback)
```

Samir: Do we have a kv-miss correlation? any batcher size/path changes after the patch? @Tina can you check batcher histograms? :thinking_face:

Tina: Looked at batcher metrics — p95 batch size stable, but socket-level wait for low-seqlen jumped 2x. Flame graph: http://perf.internal/fg/39512 (sandbox link).

Samir: Hmm. The chooser heuristic was changed to prefer the generic microkernel when kv_miss_rate > 0.6 to avoid tail blowups. That threshold might be too eager for tiny requests. For 8-token requests, kernel startup dominates.

Samir: Proposal: add token-level attribution metric with segments [prequeue, kv_lookup, kernel, decode, postqueue]. Sample at 0.1% globally, bump to 5% for flagged routes. This gives us per-token waterfall without huge cardinality.

Alex G.: +1. We also need per-route dashboard panels showing token waterfall and kernel-path ratio over time so we can see regressions tied to kernel selector rolls.

Priya: Quick probe config I tested in sandbox:
```yaml
metrics:
  token_probe:
    sample_rate: 0.001
    tags: [route, model, kernel_path, kernel_selector_version]
    buckets_ms: [1,2,5,10,20,50,100,200]
    raw_sample_ttl: 3600 # seconds
```
(keeps raw samples 1h, rollups to histograms for 14d)

deploy-bot: perf-probe deployed to sandbox at 3951234575 :white_check_mark:

Tina: Also request: include kernel_selector_version and batcher_config tag in samples so we can diff behavior by rollout. And capture kv_hit boolean per token if possible.

Samir: Agree. Implementation note: avoid per-token span tracing for all requests — it kills CPU. Use lightweight counters and occasional full-sample traces.

Alex G.: Action items:
- Alex: kick off 1% canary with token_probe enabled for /chat-stream and attach traces.
- Tina: build dashboard panels: token waterfall, kv-hit heatmap, kernel-path ratio by route + selector version.
- Priya: promote probe config to canary and ensure tags are attached.
- Samir: monitor SLOs and flame graphs, watch for p95 jumps and increase sample if needed.

Samir: I'll create an alert if route-level kernel_path_ratio shifts > 15% in 10m window.

Alex G.: Starting canary now, uploading a small trace bundle to the perf bucket. Will post link when done. :muscle:

deploy-bot: canary job started: job/ttft-sampler-canary/1345

Alex G.: Uploaded traces -> s3://perf-redwood/samples/3951234567/traces.tar.gz

Tina: Thanks — I'll wire up the dashboard panels to that dataset and add an explainer note.

Priya: If the canary shows improvement with a relaxed chooser threshold, we should consider a rolling revert or a tuned threshold for short sequences.

Alex G.: Got it. Will post canary stats in 30m.

Samir: Nice work. Keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
